text: Your drawings. Your tools. Meet Open PDF Studio. Free and open source.
Bring your technical drawings into one workspace. Explore the details, and keep your project in view.
Set the scale. Measure lengths and areas directly on your drawing. Turn project information into quantities you can use.
Add dimensions, shapes, hatches, and notes. Keep your markups where they belong: right on the drawing.
Put two versions side by side. See additions and removals, inspect the differences, and make your next review clearer.
Professional PDF tools, without a subscription. No watermarks. Open source, with the freedom to make it your own.
Your next project starts here. Open PDF Studio. Download it free, and get to work.
